name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-piranha-plant-pack
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Piranha Plant Pack
description:
Alternate redrawn-style graphics meant for many variations of the well known Piranha Plant enemy which sport a slightly tweaked head and a new stem design.

As a whole, this pack includes new graphics for:
* SMW Vanilla Piranha Plants (sans the propeller stem from the jumping ones).
* Imamelia's Custom Piranha Plant and Venus Fire Trap sprites.
* mikeyk & Davros' Giant Piranha Plant sprites.
* The Biob's Jumping Giant Piranha Plant sprite.
* Koopster's Fat Piranha Plant sprite.
* Dahnamics's Giant Piranha Boss sprite.

There are two different variations for the graphics: one where the Piranha Plants look like in newer games (as in, with red/green heads), and another in which their head is brown-ish and their lips is green/red, which meant to invoke their look from the Super Mario 64 - Mario Party 6 era of games. On a related note, the Venus Fire Trap have two extra variations: one in which their head is dark-brown like the Super Mario 3D Land/World; and another where they blow fire rather than... spew it by opening their mouths.

The palette included covers all the sprites covered in the pack. From those, only the Giant Piranha Boss uses palettes E and F while it's fire projectiles use palette A.

Credit's not required but hugely appreciated nonetheless.
